The attacker receiver had no outgoing XRP in secondary reporting through 14:40 UTC; a direct later refresh remains pending.
Binance's $1.34B aggregate market/OTC replenishment has no disclosed XRP allocation or executed XRP trade.
Circle's USDC contraction snapshot is dated Oct26 and predates the Binance incident.
CoinDesk's Binance14 PoR inclusion is Ethereum-only; it does not prove XRP source-wallet membership.
The reported Ripple 310M XRP movement has no verified transaction hashes, sale route, official purpose or incident link.
Liqwall account long share is not notional exposure; cross-provider OI remains non-comparable.
Strong Q3 GDP and moderating PCE are counterweights to the hawkish-policy/risk-off macro narrative.
